```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up .NET SDK
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
      with:
        dotnet-version: '6.0'

    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore

    - name: Analyze code with SonarQube
      uses: SonarSource/sonarcloud-github-action@master
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}

    - name: Run unit tests
      run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

    - name: Run integration tests
      run: dotnet test --filter "Category=Integration" --no-build --verbosity normal

    - name: Check code style with StyleCop
      run: dotnet tool install -g StyleCop.Tool && stylecop analyze .

    - name: Check for code smells with Roslynator
      run: dotnet tool install -g Roslynator.CSharp.Analyzers && roslynator analyze .
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a CI pipeline for the `thomhurst/ModularPipelines` repository. It includes steps to checkout the code, set up the .NET SDK, restore dependencies, analyze code with SonarQube, run unit and integration tests, check code style with StyleCop, and check for code smells with Roslynator. The workflow is triggered on pull requests to the `main` branch.
